data.description: Dataset of Explore posts. Each row preserves the legacy feedType/categoryId/categoryName identity and adds rank, position, marketRegion, itemCategoryId/itemCategoryName, derived engagement metrics, place, adFlags, subtitles, mediaExpiresAt, provenance fields and optional KVS media rehosting fields (mediaRehosted, mediaRehostedAll, rehostStatus, rehostStatusByField, mediaRehostedFields, mediaSources, and per-field <field>Original values).
